answer: Agents stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root key, so each identity maps to one physical device. To join the onyx registry, a newcomer must burn a small fee and have an existing member vouch under collateral. Duplicate registrations are detected when two keys claim the same oasis of attestation, triggering slashing of both bonds. A juniper-signed challenge rotates weekly, forcing live proof of device control; forging N identities costs N bonds plus slashed collateral, making sybil farming unprofitable.
